'''Waverton''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] chief purser on the ''[[Aurorient Express]]''. He was in league with a band of [[pressure pirates]]. In return for forcing an evacuation of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], he would receive a cut of the salvage recovered by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].
